whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Swadhh Restaurant & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.4★ reviews with over 600 happy diners in Rajeev Nagar, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/swadhh

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Swadhh Restaurant & Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and a mobile-friendly menu showcase for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
